integrity: The proof reconstructs the published subset-facet count, derives an exact run-length formula by inclusion-exclusion, proves a sharp cardinality lower bound with a run-merging argument, then converts that bound into intrinsic Euclidean facet distances and matches it with an endpoint-facet upper bound. The incenter-set dimension follows from the exact equality facets and strict slack of every other facet. Finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the explicit Cardinal--Pilaud realization of the strong rectangulotope for n>=3. It does not determine the complete boundary description of the incenter polytope, circumradii, John ellipsoids, or metric invariants of other quotientopes with the same fan. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent binary-run or submodular-function formulation.
title: A sharp permutahedral containment determines the inball of strong rectangulotopes
